text.offer: Widow Qesino says, "My husband was a sailor, and he swore by a place he called Seafarer's Peak. It's a hill above the sea, out past the Forest of Farol, and the old sailors climbed it to feel the mana there before a voyage. There's a node on the top. Go and see it for him, would you?"
text.progress: From Jasper: West Jasper, into the Forest of Farol past Faronath, out of its western edge into the Druid Hills, then the Hills, and up to Seafarer's Peak.
text.complete: He'd have liked that. Thank you, traveller.

steps.objective: Bond with the node on Seafarer's Peak
